What happens after I place an order?

India-wide to serviceable pin codes (no international shipping yet). Standard shipping is ₹20; free on orders of ₹1,000 or more. The exact amount is shown at checkout. Full details: Shipping.

Can I cancel or change my order?

Contact support as soon as possible with your order number — ideally before your order is dispatched. Address corrections should be sent immediately, before dispatch. Support will confirm what can be changed for your order.

My parcel hasn't arrived

A delivery attempt failed or my parcel was returned

Contact support with your order number and we'll check with the courier and confirm the next steps for your order. Please double-check your address and phone number at checkout to avoid failed attempts.

Damaged or wrong items

Inspect your order on arrival. If an item is defective, damaged, or not what you ordered, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and clear photos of the item and packaging. Damaged, defective or incorrect items reported in this window are handled at no cost to you.

What fabric do you use?

100% cotton. Construction details for each style are on its product page.

Contact & escalation

Email support@lucsum.com or WhatsApp +91 82728 10805. We respond within 24–48 hours, Monday–Friday. Please include your order number.

nodes.title: Care Guide
nodes.body:
Care for your LUCSUM pieces

Proper care keeps premium cotton looking and feeling its best. Always follow the sewn-in care label first.

About our cotton

All current LUCSUM tees are 100% cotton jersey.

Washing

  • Machine wash with similar colours on a gentle cycle.
  • Use cold water — hot water can shrink cotton and fade prints.
  • Turn garments inside out, especially graphic tees.
  • Do not bleach unless the label allows it.
  • Wash less often — air overnight between wears when fresh.

Drying

  • Line dry in shade where possible.
  • If tumble drying, use the lowest heat and remove while slightly damp.
  • High heat can shrink oversized tees and warp proportions.

Ironing

Iron on low to medium heat. Iron on the reverse side when possible, especially on prints and branded tape.

Storage

Fold cotton tees rather than hanging long-term. Store clean and dry, away from direct sunlight.

nodes.title: What Oversized Fit Means: Shoulders, Length and Drape
nodes.body:
Understand the oversized silhouette. By the end you'll know what makes a tee oversized (dropped shoulders, extra chest width, longer length) and why LUCSUM cuts every style this way.

At LUCSUM, oversized is not a passing trend — it is the foundation of how we design streetwear. Every piece in our T-Shirts collection is built around relaxed proportions, substantial cotton, and room to move. We believe clothing should give you space to express yourself without fighting your body. That is what BE YOUR OWN UNIVERSE means in practice: wear what feels like you, not what a size chart tells you to be.

Why oversized works for streetwear

Streetwear has always been about attitude as much as aesthetics. An oversized silhouette creates a deliberate shape — dropped shoulders, a boxy body, and sleeves that sit away from the arm rather than clinging to it. The result is a look that reads confident and unhurried, whether you are pairing a tee with wide-leg trousers or layering under an open overshirt.

Unlike a generic baggy fit, LUCSUM oversized is engineered. We think about shoulder placement, body width, and hem length together so the garment looks intentional from every angle. A tee that is wide but too short can feel accidental; one with balanced proportions feels like a choice. That intention is what separates streetwear from simply wearing clothes that are too big.

Movement, comfort, and everyday wear

Oversized clothing should make your day easier, not harder. Whether you are commuting, creating, or catching up with friends, you should not have to think about whether your shirt will ride up or pull tight across your back. Every current LUCSUM tee is 100% cotton jersey. Styles include Raglan Baseball, Celestial Graphic, Contrast Panel, Shoulder Logo and Branded Tape.

The relaxed fit also makes layering natural. An oversized tee works as a base under a jacket in cooler months, or on its own when the temperature rises. Browse our full range in the All T-Shirts collection to see how each design — from graphic statements to clean essentials — shares the same commitment to comfortable proportions.

Fit still matters — even when the fit is oversized

Oversized does not mean one-size-fits-all. Shoulder seam placement, sleeve length, and body length all change how a piece looks on different frames. That is why we publish detailed measurements and fit guidance on our Size & Fit page rather than relying on S, M, L labels alone.

If you are new to oversized dressing, start by comparing a LUCSUM garment's flat measurements with a tee you already love. Pay attention to where the shoulder sits and how long the body falls past your hip. The goal is a silhouette that feels relaxed while still looking composed — not swallowed, not sloppy.

The LUCSUM point of view

We started LUCSUM because we wanted everyday streetwear that felt considered. Oversized fit is our way of giving you room — room to move, room to layer, room to make the outfit yours. It connects directly to why we exist: premium cotton, bold details, and pieces designed for self-expression.

Read more about our philosophy on the Why LUCSUM page, then explore the latest drops in New Arrivals. However you style it, oversized should feel like an extension of your orbit — not a costume you put on for the day.

Relaxed fit. Clear intention. BE YOUR OWN UNIVERSE.

nodes.title: How to Choose Your Oversized Tee Size Using Garment Measurements
nodes.body:
Pick the right size. Use a tee you already own and our garment measurement chart to pick your size in under five minutes.

Choosing an oversized tee should feel exciting, not confusing. At LUCSUM, we design every piece in our T-Shirts collection with deliberate proportions — but the best fit is still personal. This guide walks you through how to find a silhouette that feels relaxed, looks intentional, and works with the way you actually dress.

Start with measurements, not size labels

Size names vary between brands. A medium at one label might match a large at another. That is why our Size & Fit page lists chest width, body length, and shoulder width for every garment. Before you order, lay a favourite tee flat, measure across the chest from armpit to armpit, and compare those numbers to our size chart.

If you are between sizes, think about the look you want. A true-to-chart LUCSUM size gives a clean oversized silhouette — relaxed but balanced. Sizing up adds more drape and length for a bolder streetwear shape. Neither is wrong; it depends on your proportions and styling preferences.

Shoulders set the tone

In an oversized tee, the shoulder seam typically sits lower than a classic fit — that is the dropped-shoulder look. It should still create a clean line across your upper body rather than hanging halfway down your arm. Check product photos and measurements to see where the seam lands relative to your own shoulder width.

Our Contrast Panel tee and Raglan Baseball tee use different construction at the shoulder, which changes how the fit reads. Contrast panel styles offer a classic dropped shoulder, while raglan sleeves create a smoother diagonal line — worth considering if you prefer a softer shoulder profile.

Body width and length work together

Width alone does not define oversized. A wide body with a short length can feel boxy and cropped; extra width paired with a longer hem creates the flowing streetwear silhouette most people picture. Look at both measurements together when comparing styles.

For a more dramatic look, explore pieces in our New Arrivals collection and consider sizing up one level. For everyday rotation pieces, true-to-size often delivers the sweet spot — enough room to move without excess fabric bunching at the waist.

Styling changes how fit reads

The rest of your outfit affects how oversized looks. Wide-leg trousers balance a relaxed top; a structured jacket over a roomy tee creates contrast. If you are wearing an oversized graphic from our Graphic Tees collection, keep the bottom half cleaner so the print remains the focal point.

Essentials from LUCSUM Essentials — contrast panels, raglan cuts, branded tape — are designed to anchor a wardrobe. They pair easily with denim, cargos, or shorts, making them ideal starting points if you are building your first oversized rotation.

When in doubt, reach out

Fit is personal, and we would rather you feel confident before you buy. Use our size chart, compare flat measurements, and remember that LUCSUM pieces are cut for oversized streetwear — not slim tailoring. For fabric care that keeps your fit consistent wash after wash, see our Care Guide.

The right fit is the one that makes you stop adjusting your clothes and start living in them.

nodes.title: How to Build a Streetwear Wardrobe With a Few Oversized Tees
nodes.body:
Build a small rotation. You'll leave with a simple plan: two or three neutral Essentials plus one statement piece, and how to rotate them.

A strong streetwear wardrobe is not built on quantity — it is built on pieces that work together, wear well, and still feel like you. LUCSUM Essentials exist for exactly that purpose. Our Essentials collection brings together the core silhouettes that define the brand: contrast panel construction, raglan baseball cuts, and signature branded tape details on premium oversized cotton.

What makes an essential essential

An essential should do three things: fit your lifestyle, pair with what you already own, and hold up to repeat wear. Trends come and go, but the pieces you reach for every week need dependable fabric, consistent proportions, and enough character to avoid feeling anonymous.

Every LUCSUM essential is cut oversized in 100% cotton jersey: Raglan Baseball, Contrast Panel and Branded Tape. These are the pieces you build outfits around, whether you are dressing down for errands or putting together a deliberate streetwear look.

Start with three silhouettes

If you are building from scratch, three LUCSUM shapes cover most of what you need. The Contrast Panel tee delivers clean colour blocking and a classic dropped shoulder — versatile enough for minimal outfits or layered looks. The Raglan Baseball tee adds athletic energy with its diagonal sleeve seam, ideal when you want a softer shoulder line. The Branded Tape tee carries our signature tape detail — a quiet mark of LUCSUM craft that reads from across the room.

Together, these three cover neutral days, statement-adjacent days, and everything in between. Add a graphic from our Graphic Tees collection when you want the outfit to lead with print and personality.

Colour and rotation strategy

Essentials work best when colours complement each other. Start with one neutral base — black, white, or charcoal — then add one accent colour that fits your existing wardrobe. LUCSUM contrast panels and raglan colourways are designed to mix without clashing, so you can rotate through the week without repeating the same outfit.

Check New Arrivals when you want to refresh your rotation with the latest drops. Because essentials are meant to be worn often, follow our Care Guide to keep cotton soft and shapes consistent over time.

Essentials vs. statement pieces

Not every tee in your wardrobe needs to shout. Essentials balance the louder pieces — like the Celestial Graphic tee or Shoulder Logo tee — by giving you reliable options on days when the fit and fabric do the talking.

Think of your wardrobe as an orbit: essentials are the gravity that keeps everything grounded; graphics and logos are the satellites that add movement and expression. Both matter. LUCSUM designs for that balance.

Make it yours

The final step in building a streetwear wardrobe is wearing it your way. Tuck, half-tuck, layer under an open shirt, pair with wide trousers or shorts — essentials adapt because their proportions are generous and their details are intentional. That is the LUCSUM approach: fewer pieces, better reasons to wear them.

Explore the full Essentials collection, read about our fit philosophy on Why LUCSUM, and build a rotation that feels unmistakably yours. BE YOUR OWN UNIVERSE starts with what you reach for every morning.

nodes.title: How to Wash and Dry Cotton Tees So They Keep Their Shape
nodes.body:
Make your tees last. Practical washing, drying and stain steps for 100% cotton tees. For the quick checklist, see our Care Guide.

Every current LUCSUM tee is 100% cotton jersey, including Raglan Baseball, Celestial Graphic, Contrast Panel, Shoulder Logo and Branded Tape. Cotton rewards good habits. Whether you live in our Essentials collection or rotate through Graphic Tees, a few consistent care habits will keep your pieces looking sharp wash after wash.

Wash less, air more

Cotton does not need to hit the machine after every single wear. If a tee smells fresh and looks clean, hang it to air overnight — especially for oversized fits that breathe well away from the body. Fewer washes mean less fibre stress, less fading on prints, and a longer life for taped seams and contrast panels.

When it is time to wash, turn graphic tees inside out to protect prints. Close zippers and empty pockets on anything going in the same load to avoid snagging.

Follow the fundamentals

Cold or lukewarm water is your friend. Hot water can shrink cotton and accelerate colour loss — particularly on contrast panel and raglan colourways. Use a mild detergent without harsh bleaches, and skip fabric softener if you want to preserve the natural hand-feel of premium cotton.

Our full Care Guide page covers garment-specific notes, but the rule of thumb for every LUCSUM tee is gentle cycle, cold wash, and low heat or air dry. Treat branded tape and printed graphics with the same care you would give any detail you want to last.

Drying: low heat or line dry

High heat is the fastest way to shrink an oversized tee and warp its proportions. If you use a tumble dryer, choose the lowest heat setting and remove the garment while it is still slightly damp. Reshape the shoulders and lay flat or hang to finish drying.

Line drying is ideal for maintaining the relaxed silhouette that defines LUCSUM fit. Oversized pieces benefit from gravity pulling the hem straight — just avoid prolonged direct sunlight on dark colours, which can fade over time.

Storage that preserves shape

Fold cotton tees rather than hanging them long-term. Hangers can stretch the shoulder line on oversized garments, especially when the fabric is wet or damp. Store in a cool, dry place with space to breathe — not compressed under heavier items that can crease branded tape or contrast panels.

If you are rotating through multiple pieces from our T-Shirts collection, give each tee room in the drawer. Essentials like the Branded Tape tee and Contrast Panel tee are designed for frequent wear — storing them properly means they are ready when you are.

Handle stains quickly

Address spills as soon as you can. Blot — do not rub — and use cold water on the spot before it sets. For oil or food stains, a gentle pre-treat before a cold wash usually does the job. Avoid aggressive scrubbing on printed areas; pat the stain from the back of the fabric when possible.

Care is part of the brand experience

LUCSUM is built on the idea that better everyday clothing should last. Taking care of your tees is not extra work — it is how you protect the fit, colour, and feel that made you choose them in the first place. Pair these habits with our Size & Fit guidance so your pieces continue to drape the way they did on day one.

Browse Essentials and New Arrivals when you are ready to add to a wardrobe you actually maintain. Wear often. Care thoughtfully. BE YOUR OWN UNIVERSE.

nodes.title: How to Style Graphic Tees: Outfit Ideas for Statement Prints
nodes.body:
Style a statement tee. Outfit formulas for letting a graphic lead, using Celestial Graphic Black and Shoulder Logo Charcoal as examples.

Graphic tees are where self-expression meets streetwear — and LUCSUM treats them as statement pieces, not afterthoughts. Our Graphic Tees collection pairs bold design with the same premium oversized cotton and considered proportions as the rest of the brand. The question is not whether to wear a graphic; it is how to style it so the print lands with intention.

Let the graphic lead

A strong graphic tee deserves visual space. When you wear the Celestial Graphic tee, let the celestial print be the focal point — pair it with neutral bottoms in black, stone, or washed denim. Avoid competing patterns on trousers or jackets; the oversized silhouette already creates presence, and the print completes the statement.

The Shoulder Logo tee works differently: the mark sits at the shoulder rather than centre chest, which means you can layer an open overshirt or unzipped hoodie without hiding the design. Think of it as a signature detail that rewards a closer look — perfect for outfits that feel understated until someone notices the placement.

Balance proportion

Oversized graphics need balanced outfits. If the top is wide and bold, keep the lower half cleaner — straight or wide-leg trousers, relaxed denim, or structured shorts in solid colours. Footwear can add energy: chunky sneakers ground a celestial print; minimal leather shoes refine a shoulder-logo look for evening.

Layering adds depth without drowning the tee. A plain oversized hoodie worn open frames a graphic; a longline coat in neutral tone lets the hem of the tee peek through. Browse the full T-Shirts collection to see how graphics relate to our essentials in scale and proportion.

Colour coordination

Pull one colour from the graphic and repeat it subtly elsewhere — socks, a cap, or a bag strap. You do not need a full colour match; a single echo is enough to make the outfit feel composed. For the Celestial Graphic, deep navy or charcoal bottoms mirror the print's mood; for Shoulder Logo charcoal, white or cream trousers create high contrast.

When in doubt, monochrome below the waist is the safest move. Graphic tees from New Arrivals often introduce seasonal colour stories — check each product page for exact tones before you build the rest of the look.

Occasion and attitude

Graphic streetwear works across contexts if you calibrate the surrounding pieces. For casual days, graphic plus joggers or cargos reads effortless. For something sharper, swap joggers for pressed wide trousers and clean sneakers — the oversized tee becomes the relaxed counterpoint to a more structured bottom.

LUCSUM graphics are designed for BE YOUR OWN UNIVERSE energy: wear them when you want your outfit to say something. Pair with essentials from LUCSUM Essentials on other days to keep the rotation balanced.

Care keeps graphics crisp

Statement prints last longer when you wash inside out on cold, air dry when possible, and avoid high-heat drying. See our Care Guide for full details. A faded graphic loses impact — proper care protects the investment you made in self-expression.

Build your graphic rotation

Start with one centre-chest statement and one shoulder-detail piece — that gives you two distinct styling modes. Add essentials in neutral tones so you are never forcing a graphic when the day calls for quiet. Explore Graphic Tees, read about fit on our Size & Fit page, and wear prints that feel like your orbit — not someone else's trend calendar.

nodes.title: Contrast Panel vs Raglan Baseball: Which Oversized Tee Suits You?
nodes.body:
Compare two silhouettes. A side-by-side of the Contrast Panel and Raglan Baseball: shoulder line, look, and which to buy first.

Not all oversized tees are built the same way. Two of the most popular shapes in our LUCSUM Essentials collection — the contrast panel and the raglan baseball cut — share premium cotton and relaxed proportions, but they create different lines on the body. Here is how to choose the silhouette that fits your style.

Contrast Panel: clean blocks, classic shoulders

The Contrast Panel tee uses colour-blocked panels — typically a body colour with contrasting sleeves or side panels — to create visual structure without relying on graphics. The shoulder seam follows a classic dropped-shoulder line, which gives a boxy, streetwear-forward shape that reads sharp from the front and back.

Contrast panels work well if you like outfits built on colour geometry: pair a black body with contrasting sleeves against neutral trousers, or lean into the colour story with matching accents in footwear. It is the essential for people who want their tee to add visual interest through construction rather than print.

Raglan Baseball: softer shoulders, athletic ease

The Raglan Baseball tee replaces the straight shoulder seam with a diagonal raglan sleeve that runs from underarm to collar. That line softens the shoulder profile and adds a subtle athletic reference — think relaxed baseball tee energy scaled up to oversized streetwear proportions.

Raglan cuts drape differently across the upper chest. The diagonal seam draws the eye inward, which can feel slightly less boxy than a contrast panel on certain frames. If you find dropped shoulders too broad visually, raglan is often the more forgiving entry point into LUCSUM oversized fit.

Fabric and weight: style-specific

Both are 100% cotton jersey; see the Contrast Panel and Raglan Baseball product pages for full details. The difference you'll notice most is the shoulder line, not the fabric. Follow our Care Guide to maintain the drape and colour contrast that define each style.

For exact measurements on each product, visit our Size & Fit page. Raglan and contrast panel pieces may differ slightly in chest width and sleeve length even at the same size label, so compare flat measurements if you are choosing between both.

Styling each silhouette

Contrast panels shine in minimal outfits — let the panel lines do the work with solid bottoms and clean sneakers. Raglan tees pair naturally with cargos, track pants, and layered hoodies; the athletic seam line complements sport-influenced streetwear without looking like gym wear.

Both styles sit comfortably within a broader wardrobe that includes Graphic Tees for statement days. Think of contrast panel and raglan as your weekday essentials, with graphics reserved for when you want the outfit to broadcast louder.

Which should you pick first?

If you gravitate toward clean lines and colour blocking, start with the Contrast Panel tee. If you prefer a softer shoulder and subtle sport reference, start with the Raglan Baseball tee. Many LUCSUM customers eventually own both — they solve different outfit problems.

Explore the full Essentials collection, see everything in context via our All T-Shirts collection, and pick the silhouette that matches your orbit. You can always add the other when you are ready to expand.

Same brand. Style-specific cotton. Different energy. BE YOUR OWN UNIVERSE.

Not every LUCSUM detail shouts. Some of the best ones reward attention — like the branded tape that defines our signature essential. The Branded Tape tee is a centrepiece of the LUCSUM Essentials collection, built for people who want craft and character without centre-chest graphics.

What branded tape means at LUCSUM

Branded tape is a woven or printed tape insert — often at the shoulder, hem, or neckline — that carries the LUCSUM mark in a refined, repeated format. It is a construction detail borrowed from premium sportswear and workwear, adapted for oversized streetwear proportions. The tape adds visual structure and brand presence without dominating the chest.

On a plain oversized body, that small repeated mark creates rhythm: your eye catches it when you move, when you layer, when someone stands close enough to notice the finish. It is the kind of detail that separates a basic tee from a LUCSUM tee.

Design philosophy: quiet distinction

LUCSUM exists at the intersection of self-expression and everyday wear. Graphic tees in our Graphic Tees collection speak loudly; branded tape speaks precisely. It is for days when you want the fit and fabric to lead, with a signature that feels personal rather than promotional.

This aligns with BE YOUR OWN UNIVERSE — not every outfit needs to broadcast. Sometimes confidence looks like wearing something well-made that only you and people who notice details will fully read.

Fit and fabric

The Branded Tape tee is cut in 100% cotton jersey, the same fabric construction as our Contrast Panel. Oversized proportions, dropped shoulder and generous body width keep the tape in proportion rather than feeling like an afterthought label.

Consult our Size & Fit page for measurements. Because the tee is designed as a wardrobe anchor, getting the right size matters: true-to-size for a clean oversized look, or size up for extra drape.

How to style branded tape

Branded tape tees are among the most versatile pieces LUCSUM makes. Wear solo with wide denim and sneakers for an everyday orbit; layer under an open shirt or lightweight jacket so the tape peek shows at the hem or collar. They pair cleanly with statement bottoms — patterned cargos, bold footwear — because the top stays refined.

Build a core rotation with the Contrast Panel and Raglan Baseball tees for shape variety, and let branded tape be the piece you reach for when you want minimal with meaning.

Caring for taped details

Tape inserts can stress if you wash hot or tumble dry aggressively. Turn the tee inside out, cold wash, low heat or air dry — the same approach we outline in our full Care Guide. Proper care keeps tape flat, colour-true, and aligned with the garment's shape.

The signature essential

If you are curating a LUCSUM wardrobe with intention, branded tape belongs in the conversation early. It connects to our Why LUCSUM story — considered details, premium cotton, oversized fit for self-expression. Shop the Branded Tape tee and explore the wider T-Shirts collection to see how one small detail can define an entire piece.
